summary: WebRender, Firefox’s GPU compositor, now does more of its clipping, batching, and visibility work directly in device space, reducing repeated coordinate conversions and limiting image sampling to pixels that are actually visible. Borders, text, glyphs, and line decorations are rasterized using the target surface’s scale, improving sharpness across zoom levels, high-DPI displays, perspective transforms, and nested surfaces; backdrop-filter and underlay/overlay handling also received important correctness fixes. Cleanup of unused paths and new Wrench reftests make the compositor simpler to maintain and better covered by tests.
